claims: The federal income tax filing deadline for 2025 returns is April 15, 2026, for most taxpayers.
An automatic 6-month extension to file extends the deadline to October 15, 2026.
An extension to file is not an extension to pay.
Taxes owed are still due by April 15, 2026.
The deadline for individual returns is April 15, 2026.
The deadline for extension to file is October 15, 2026.
The deadline for partnerships and S-Corps is March 16, 2026.
Estimated tax payments are due April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15, 2027.
